name: Animals in the news
subject: Environment · Biodiversity
aarav: So I memorise every animal in the news?
priya: Look closer. Most ask how and where they live.
pattern_h: The news picks it. UPSC tests how it lives.

traps.p: One-horned rhinos also live in Nepal; only the Asiatic lion is India‑only (2019).

items: Asiatic lion is naturally found in India only.
Double-humped camel is naturally found in India only.
One-horned rhinoceros is naturally found in India only.
q.prompt: Which of the statements given above is/are correct?

walk.priya: Rhinos also live in Nepal's Terai. One exception breaks "only".

traps.p: Some turtles, fish and sea mammals are herbivores: true (2019).

items: Some species of turtles are herbivores.
Some species of fish are herbivores.
Some species of marine mammals are herbivores.
Some species of snakes are viviparous.
q.prompt: Which of the statements given above are correct?

walk.priya: "Some" needs just one example: the green turtle eats seagrass.

q.stem: Which of the following is not a bird?

walk.aarav: Nightjar? Sounds like a jar, not a bird.
walk.priya: Golden Mahseer is a fish of Himalayan rivers. The other three are birds.

pyqs.gist: What does the Amur falcons' stop at Doyang show?
Which have toxic species: butterflies, fish, frogs?
